label: HMAC Auth
description: Gate a Route with a shared secret the caller signs each request with, typical for webhooks. The caller sends `X-Timestamp: <unix seconds>` and `X-Signature: <hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<timestamp>.<raw body>" under the secret>`; a timestamp more than five minutes off is refused as a replay. `caller` is `{}`. Another signing scheme needs its own access node with its own `verify` block.

fields.name: signing_secret
fields.label: Signing secret
fields.placeholder: the secret the caller signs with
